shortDescription: ZUG, Switzerland, Oct. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Lithium Argentina AG (“Lithium Argentina” or the “Company”) (TSX: LAR) (NYSE: LAR) will release its third quarter 2026 earnings results before market open on Tuesday, November 10, 2026.The Company will hold a webcast and conference call to discuss…

children: ) will release its third quarter 2026 earnings results before market open on Tuesday, November 10, 2026.

The Company will hold a webcast and conference call to discuss its third quarter 2026 results on Tuesday, November 10, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. ET. The webcast will be accessible on the Investor Relations section of the Company website at
Event Title: Lithium Argentina Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call
Start Time: 10:00 AM Eastern time (US and Canada)
A webcast replay will be available following the conclusion of the event through the News and Events page at https://investors.lithium-argentina.com/news-events/events.

Lithium Argentina, in partnership with Ganfeng, operates the Cauchari-Olaroz lithium brine operation in Argentina and is advancing additional lithium resources in the region. Lithium Argentina currently trades on the TSX and on the NYSE.

title: Lithium Argentina to Release Third Quarter 2026 Results on November 10, 2026
